title: Logarithmic transport at topological phase transitions of one-dimensional chiral quantum systems
summary: The random hopping Hamiltonian is a toy model for a disorder-driven topological phase transitions in one-dimensional chiral Hamiltonians. It has a vanishing Lyapunov exponent and a Dyson peak in the density of states at zero energy. This work shows how the quantum dynamics leads to a logarithmic growth of the moments of the position operator, similar as in classical Sinai diffusion.
